sessionStart.command:
echo `# <#` > /dev/null
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); case "$(git -C "$root" ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit 2>/dev/null)" in 160000*) rules="$root/.vendor/workflow-kit/AGENT_RULES.md"; [ -f "$rules" ] || { GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -C "$root" submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -f "$rules" ] || printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit missing or incomplete: from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)"}'; };; esac
exit #> > $null 2>&1
$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; $rules = "$root/.vendor/workflow-kit/AGENT_RULES.md"; if ($root -and ((git -C $root ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit) -match '^160000') -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rules -PathType Leaf)) { $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'; $env:GIT_ASKPASS = 'true'; $env:SSH_ASKPASS = 'true'; git -C $root submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit *> $null; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rules -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit missing or incomplete: from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)"}' } }; exit 0

echo `# <#` > /dev/null
launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$launcher" activate cursor; fi
printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}'
exit #> > $null 2>&1
$launcher=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.cmd'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf) { & $launcher activate cursor; if (-not $? -and -not $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 1 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}'
